first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Large sections of teal seats arranged in stepped tiers, with gray passageways and light-colored boundaries between sections.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The large-span gray canopy above the stands, with repeated trusses, diagonal braces, and segmented roof panels.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: The pink-purple illuminated frame gate beside the display screen is primarily trackable in this clip; in the later portion, it appears as a flattened, elongated frame due to the oblique view.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: Repeatedly arranged white, highly luminous light fixtures and localized intense light along the roof edge.

entities.name: upper-level black display screen
entities.identification: A black rectangular display screen near the upper-level stands, with highly luminous light-colored graphics.

entities.name: platform below the display screen
entities.identification: A long gray platform structure extending along the lower edge of the display screen, with a railing along its edge.

entities.name: light-colored railing
entities.identification: Light-colored horizontal rails and vertical members along the edge of the stands and the edge of the platform below the display screen.
